posts.title: SoonPho Motorized Tripod Head with Wireless Remote
posts.description: Review of the SoonPho ‘M-6 Remote and Tracking PanTilt’. This motorized tripod head gives you wireless remote control for positioning your camera up to 30 meters away. For vloggers, it can track your face with its embedded camera.

posts.title: Tethered Shooting Time Lag
posts.description: Find out what kind of time delay to expect when using tethering software to remotely control your camera from a computer. Compare USB cabling to Ethernet.

posts.title: Tethered Shooting with Capture One and the Nikon Z9
posts.description: How to perform tethered shooting using the Capture One program and an Ethernet cable. This article gives specific instructions for the Nikon Z9, but models from Canon, Fujifilm, Leica, Nikon, Phase One, Sigma, and Sony are also supported. USB cables can also be used instead of Ethernet. My 100-foot Ethernet cable works just fine!
